reviews.title: Great for the price and ease.
reviews.comment: Running this in an older 14 core I9 machine that had a custom waterloop using all EKWB parts. The pump burnt out (I think from a very tiny leak in pump unit) and was looking for a cheap upgrade as buying a new pump is so pricey now. This fit the bill as it comes with an x299 adapter. So far it's been stellar, super quiet and keeps the temps cooler than the EKWB, most likely from the 320mm rad vs the 240 I had been running. Good buy for the pricing and keeping it pretty simple.
reviews.author: Backlight

reviews.title: Excellent cooling performance, especially for the price
reviews.comment: I’m using this to cool a Ryzen 9950X3D and it’s been perfect. Temps stay impressively low even under load — it keeps things cool as hell without any drama. I honestly hadn’t heard of this brand before, but after seeing GamersNexus give it a solid review, I figured it was worth a shot. The price almost felt too good to be true, but it absolutely isn’t. Installation was straightforward, it runs quietly, and performance has been excellent so far. If you’re looking for serious cooling without paying premium-brand prices, this is an easy recommendation.
reviews.author: Mor

reviews.title: 10 out of 10
reviews.comment: Best part of my build. Looks clean, really cools and functions well.
reviews.author: Chance Hyatt

reviews.title: I'm A Happy Helldiver
reviews.comment: This thing is classy, effective, and easy to install. Comes with all the screws you need to mount it in your case. Comes officially packaged and is overall a top-tier AIO cooler. It ain't about RGB lighting. It's about keeping your CPU cool so that you can game in peace and get the best performance out of your PC. My Ryzen 5 7700X is living its best life and chillin' while I play Helldivers 2.
reviews.author: Trisonix, Gamer for more than 10 years and small streamer.

reviews.title: Decent aio easy to install had to get another!
reviews.comment: So I am rewriting my review. Because I underestimated this aio. Not only is it super easy to install. But if you put it in the right case with the right fan orientation, it can be a super good at cooling with stock fans or non-stock fans. This aio was so good that I went and bought a second one for another build for my girlfriend
